categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Has the Private Broadcast label and tests the behavior of P2P private broadcast transaction staleness tracking in src/test/fuzz/private_broadcast.cpp.
categories.rationale: Improves test coverage for private broadcast transaction retry logic by asserting that GetStale() returns the complete set of stale transactions. As noted in the description, mutant testing showed that replacing continue with break in GetStale() previously passed all tests without detection.

categories.rationale: Modifies test assertions specific to the private broadcast module rather than test framework machinery or shared fuzzing infrastructure.
